checks.finding: The exact 124909a8f1da6d1e3a52d841aaf4d5e7fbfd877b..9eee066e0a72cb2d7941bce98489678f58a11655 diff changes six files. Runtime changes are limited to an eight-line strict UTC evidence serializer and one fold-evidence boundary call; all remaining changes are focused tests, authorization, and controller/evidence plumbing.

The serializer only transforms an evidence-field value after row indexing, session construction, fill construction, and terminal-fill selection. The economic module and its tests are byte-identical before and after repair, so rows, identities, gaps, eligibility, signals, targets, fills, clocks, prices, costs, sizing, accounting, returns, trials, statistics, gates, and holdout rules are unchanged.

Across pre-repair, implementation, checkpoint, and HEAD, PREREGISTRATION.json remains byte SHA-256 f8eb130bb3c1fc1670e369fa3b54007ee847bd6e4714ccfff28066a96124f567 and canonical SHA-256 5f4d41bbd9f3fc34b29e86da271d324a442520c87bacece160627c6051cd13b6; the effective contract remains byte SHA-256 1da897a3eff60a013181d6381fc20b9e7e1678cad6005dd6c9224fdb15385a77 and canonical SHA-256 9fca7dacc8fa2c58842b230763f6c33900e0ef0eb6055253ae0d559948aae8b1.

The promoted bound artifact names implementation commit 9eee066e0a72cb2d7941bce98489678f58a11655. Its pipeline, validation-driver, and production-test hashes exactly match those files at that commit: 3072c75e..., 204d79d0..., and 3c2f0cc2..., respectively.

verify_source_identity validates the exact 36-entry development allowlist and guards every selected relative path before read_verified_entry constructs a market-file candidate. The stage log records 36 development entries and zero holdout entries before market-path resolution; committed evidence records no holdout path, footer, or value access.

The evidence is internally linked and consistent: 36 partition rows sum to 790558 per asset; the partition manifest recomputes exactly; all four fold stage counts match the bound artifact; terminal-fill, session/trace, eligible/fill, and target/fill/disposition links agree; trace, cost, and representative-return manifests recompute exactly; both 14-bps and 28-bps representative reconciliations independently match.

The correctly bound run records exit status 0, 257.48 wall-clock seconds under the 1800-second ceiling, zero swaps, and no deadline trigger. The monotonic 47-record stage log ends with complete_artifact_written and the exact promoted artifact hash, so no partial result was promoted.

The mistyped declaration 9eee0662e5a8167f3ae3648306de05fdd25da314 is preserved as INVOCATION_ABORTED_COMMIT_BINDING_MISMATCH and explicitly barred from supporting a pass. Its substantive output equals the correctly bound rerun after excluding binding-specific fields; only the correctly bound rerun is promoted.

The artifacts explicitly record no aggregate strategy returns, Sharpe, drawdown, bootstrap, DSR, PBO, acceptance gates, economic result, performance claim, candidate promotion, or profitability conclusion. Only bounded representative mechanical accounting was reconciled.

Focused and repository-wide test results are recorded solely as tooling evidence. The validation artifact still classifies the result as pre-fidelity production mechanics, disallows performance claims, and requires this separate fidelity gate.

No substantive local implementation-fidelity defect was found. The implementation is fidelity-approved only for a separate formal development economic evaluation under the unchanged frozen preregistration; this approval is not an economic result or profitability claim.
